title: Fire safety measures for EV chargers in HDB car parks
asked: Ms Yeo Wan Ling asked what measures ensure HDB car parks meet safety standards for electric fires from EVs and EV chargers, given more charging points and EVs.
response: Mr Alvin Tan said HDB car parks are built to the SCDF Fire Code, with hose reels, fire engine access and ventilation to disperse smoke and heat. EV chargers in HDB car parks must meet Technical Reference 25. He said SCDF works with the community, including first responders and PA's C2E, on fire safety awareness, and that LTA and SCDF regularly review fire safety requirements through a multi-agency EV Battery Safety Taskforce. He pointed to MHA replies for broader EV fire safety questions.

key_points.point: HDB car parks are designed and built to comply with the SCDF Fire Code.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: all Housing and Development Board (HDB) car parks are designed and constructed in compliance with the prevailing Fire Code stipulated by the Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF).

key_points.point: Fire safety provisions include hose reels, fire engine access and natural or mechanical ventilation.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: This includes provisions such as hose reels, fire engine access and natural or mechanical ventilation to disperse smoke and heat.

key_points.point: EV chargers in HDB car parks must meet Technical Reference 25.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: All EV chargers installed in HDB car parks must comply with the technical specifications and safety requirements under the Technical Reference 25

key_points.point: SCDF works with the community, including first responders and PA's C2E, on fire safety awareness.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: SCDF works with the community to raise general awareness on fire safety. That includes working with first responders, People's Association's C2E and other community groups.

key_points.point: LTA and SCDF regularly review fire safety requirements through a multi-agency EV Battery Safety Taskforce.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: The Land Transport Authority and SCDF also regularly review these fire safety requirements to support the overall adoption of EV in Singapore through their multi-agency EV Battery Safety Taskforce.

key_points.point: For broader EV fire safety questions, the Minister pointed to MHA replies in Parliament.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: I would also like to point her, if she has further questions with regard to overall EV fire safety and fire safety as a whole, to the Ministry of Home Affairs' replies in Parliament on the matter.
